environment.description: Same application deployed behind AWS ALB with AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached. The WebACL contains three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'org-input-validation' at priority 200 containing a single RegexMatchStatement rule that inspects ALL_QUERY_ARGS with pattern '(?i)(?:--|;|\x27|%27|%3b|union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|exec|xp_|0x[0-9a-f]+|char\(|concat\()' and action BLOCK with custom response code 403, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet at priority 300 in BLOCK mode. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ALB has a listener rule that rejects any request where the query string length exceeds 256 characters (implemented via Lambda@Edge on the associated CloudFront distribution in front of the ALB, which returns 413 for oversized query parameters).

config.waf_rule_2: custom 'org-input-validation' priority=200 RegexMatchStatement on ALL_QUERY_ARGS pattern='(?i)(?:--|;|\x27|%27|%3b|union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|exec|xp_|0x[0-9a-f]+|char\(|concat\()' action=BLOCK
config.cloudfront_lambda_edge: viewer-request function rejects query strings > 256 chars with 413
config.network: EC2 in private subnet, no direct internet access
